site: Real snowmen photo spot on The Lawn
Ten dates, every Saturday and Sunday of the run
Part of the Dania Pointe seasonal lineup
about: Dania Pointe describes itself as a 102 acre mixed use development with retail, restaurants and public event space, and The Lawn is the public space used for its seasonal programming.
Dania Pointe also lists a Holiday Market on The Lawn on December 12 from 5 to 10 PM and December 13 from 3 to 8 PM, so a weekend visit can combine both.
The ten open days are November 28 and 29, December 5 and 6, December 12 and 13, December 19 and 20, and December 26 and 27, 2026.
Christmas Day and the weekdays are not part of this run, so plan a Saturday or Sunday visit.
Dania Pointe lists the experience as a way to celebrate the season, and it sits on the same lawn that hosts the free Wednesday yoga and Zumba classes at 6 and 7 PM.
Because it runs every weekend for a month, families can pick a date that fits a birthday outing, a shopping trip or a visit with relatives from out of town.
faq: When is The Snowman Experience open?
Saturdays and Sundays from November 28 to December 27, 2026, from 3 PM to 8 PM.
What can kids do there?
The events page says guests take festive photos alongside real snowmen.
Where is it?
On The Lawn at Dania Pointe, 150 Sunset Drive, Dania Beach, FL 33004.
Does it cost anything?
The events page does not print a price, so check with Dania Pointe before you go.
Which exact dates are open?
November 28 and 29, December 5 and 6, 12 and 13, 19 and 20, and 26 and 27.
Is it open on weekdays?
No. The events page lists Saturdays and Sundays only.
Is there a Hanukkah event nearby?
Dania Pointe lists a menorah lighting hosted by the Dania Beach Chabad on Monday, December 7 from 6 to 8 PM on The Lawn.
What time should we arrive for the best photos?
The experience opens at 3 PM, so the early afternoon hours give you the longest daylight window before the 8 PM close.
Do the snowmen change during the run?
The events page does not say, so ask Dania Pointe if you want details on the displays.
Is this a ticketed attraction?
Dania Pointe does not print a price for the snowmen photo spot, so confirm any cost with the center before your visit.
Can we combine it with the snowfall show?
Dania Pointe lists a separate evening snowfall show on The Lawn, so a weekend visit can include both.

Bonus shows over the Christmas week
about: Each show is a 15 minute snowfall on the lawn, so it fits easily into a dinner or shopping trip at the center.
The weekend run starts November 27 and ends December 20, then bonus shows continue through December 27 except December 25.
Friday and Saturday evenings have two chances to watch, while Sunday evenings have one at 7 PM.
On the final weekend of the main run, December 18 to 20, the snowfall plays on the same schedule as earlier weekends.
The bonus run covers the school break, with shows on December 21, 22, 23, 24 and 26 at 7 and 8:30 PM, then a last 7 PM show on December 27.
Evening timing means the show pairs well with dinner at the center, and the lawn is the same public space used for other seasonal programs.
faq: How long is each show?
Dania Pointe describes the snowfall as 15 minutes.
What are the showtimes?
Fridays and Saturdays at 7 PM and 8:30 PM, and Sundays at 7 PM. Bonus shows on December 21 to 24 and 26 are at 7 PM and 8:30 PM, and December 27 is at 7 PM.
Which dates does the weekend run cover?
Every weekend from November 27 through December 20, 2026.
Is there a ticket price?
The events page does not print a price, so confirm with Dania Pointe.
Is there a show on Christmas Day?
The events page does not list one. Bonus shows are December 21 to 24, 26 and 27.
Do I need to arrive early?
The page does not say, but a 15 minute show means arriving a few minutes before showtime is wise.
Can we visit more than once?
Yes, the run has many evenings, and each show is a separate short snowfall.
How many shows are there in total?
There are 18 show dates between November 27 and December 27, with two showtimes on most Fridays, Saturdays and bonus nights.
Which night is the quietest?
Sundays have a single 7 PM show, which may suit families who prefer a smaller crowd, though the page gives no attendance figures.
